title: Claude runtime closure pin and re-observation
description: Objective: provide the real pre-activation Windows Claude runtime preparation seam. Deliverable: an internal @moe/runner module that resolves the quote-declared installed runtime closure without a shell, canonicalizes and streams SHA-256 for every entry, creates a private content-addressed copy, verifies the copied bytes and re-hashes the source to close copy-time drift, re-observes current platform and the quote-bound version/capability facts, and returns an immutable prepared-runtime binding. The later launcher consumes this binding; this task performs no grant consumption or provider launch. NOT in scope: Job Objects/process execution, daemon/store orchestration, review/evidence receipts, or public launcher export. Real consumer: Windows Claude launch wrapper task task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-runtime-pin.ts, claude-runtime-pin.js, and claude-runtime-pin.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: The production surface resolves every declared closure path on Windows, rejects missing/non-file/duplicate/reparse/UNC/device or containment-escaping entries, and streams each file digest without whole-file buffering; each refusal returns exact stable RUNTIME code and layer with truth UNKNOWN.

Pinning writes only to a private digest-addressed root, never overwrites mismatching existing bytes, verifies every destination digest, and re-hashes every source after copy; drift, partial copy, cleanup failure, or unverifiable metadata remains UNKNOWN and grants no prepared runtime.

A fresh ProviderRuntimeObservation records the current OS/architecture/version, CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY, exact canonical pinned paths/digests, and capability-schema binding; comparison ignores freshness only and rejects any authoritative path/digest/version/capability/platform mismatch with the exact production code/layer.

Non-Windows invocation returns typed UNSUPPORTED before filesystem mutation; empty/UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED observations cannot be upgraded, and generated refusal sweeps assert a positive case count plus exact code and layer.

The immutable prepared-runtime result binds the quoted observation digest, fresh observation digest, aggregate pinned-closure digest, executable path, and pin-root identity so a later launcher cannot substitute bytes or location.

Focused runner typecheck/tests exit 0, including a large streaming fixture, copy-time mutation, destination collision, path attack, and byte-level deterministic rebuild cases; no probe, pin, or generated evidence files remain committed.
taskRails: Preparation is inert: it may read/hash/copy runtime bytes but must not execute Claude, consume an activation grant, acquire provider authority, or call daemon/store services.
Use the existing production ProviderRuntimeObservation builder; do not reimplement its canonical digest rules in a test helper.
TDD; exact stable reason code and layer for every failure, positive generated case counts, and production-surface mutation checks.
Keep production files focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.
